# i3-style

Make your i3 config a little more stylish.

About

i3-style applies a theme to your i3 config file to change the colorscheme of window decorations and the different parts of i3bar. It is designed especially for people who frequently change colorschemes.

- Easy to try out new themes.
- Themes are easy to read, modify, and share.
- Modifies your theme in place; templates are not required.

Usage

Call the tool with the name of the theme (or a path to a theme file) and the output location. The tool will apply the theme to your i3 configuration.

    i3-style solarized -o ~/.config/i3/config --reload

    i3-style ~/.config/i3/solarized.yaml -o ~/.config/i3/config

Send us themes!
